7.2.9 Trigger: T_BUS_OFF
[SWS_CanSM_00606] ⌈The callback function CanSM_ControllerBusOff (ref. to
[SWS_CanSM_00064]) shall trigger the state machine CANSM_BSM for the CAN network with T_BUS_OFF, if one of its configured CAN controllers matches to the function parameter ControllerId of the callback function CanSM_ControllerBusOff.⌋ (SRS_Can_01144, SRS_Can_01146)
